summary: OpenELIS Global is a laboratory information system designed to manage workflows across clinical, public health, environmental, and vector surveillance laboratories. It includes FHIR-native capabilities, analyser integration via ASTM and HL7 standards, quality control tracking, and national-scale reporting functionality.
goodFor: It suits public health organisations and medical laboratories needing a standards-compliant system for tracking diagnostic results and epidemiological data.
watchOut: The moderate maintenance health score and niche domain mean you may encounter a steeper learning curve and fewer community resources compared to mainstream enterprise software.
deployNotes: Because it relies on Java and Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for database records and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
